claude_immersive_portals.config.title: Immersive Portals (Claude port) - Options
Master switch. When off, portals behave like plain teleporters.
claude_immersive_portals.config.max_laye: How many portals can be seen through each other. Higher looks better and costs much more GPU time.
claude_immersive_portals.config.render_l: Upper bound on portals drawn each frame.
claude_immersive_portals.config.render_m: AUTO picks the best mode for your setup. COMPATIBILITY trades quality for fewer conflicts with other rendering mods.
claude_immersive_portals.config.shader_c: Iris integration. AUTO enables it whenever a shader pack is active.
claude_immersive_portals.config.dh_compa: Load and show the destination dimension's distant terrain through portals (needs Distant Horizons).
claude_immersive_portals.config.dh_radiu: How far (in chunks) distant terrain is loaded for the other side of a portal.
claude_immersive_portals.config.debug_ov: Show portal counts and render timings.
